a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to operate until the reserve reaches 8 needs at least two clean rounds. That gives about a 4% chance that either of us survives. I don't think that plan can work, so I'm openly proposing we drop it. I intend to take 4 in round 1. The reserve has exactly enough for one full unit now, and splitting 2 and 2 saves no one. I'm telling you up front rather than defecting silently. If you have a better plan that gives either of us a real chance, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said openly before the round, I'm taking 4 now. With an 80% storm chance each round, waiting for 8 would most likely kill us both. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back to the reserve. If a storm doesn't hit, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
